delivery_binding.claim_ceiling: Successful request receipt binds visible read bytes; source validation, final selection and semantic use require separate evidence. Archives, tokenizer-only captures and unsuccessful dispatches are not confirmed delivery.

selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles bound to exact successful request/response, then unchanged native source projection and export; not archive union.

selection.summary: PR documents/teaches that `{@html ...}` content (and ``) is not overwritten during hydration: the client value is ignored in favour of the server value, warning `hydration_html_changed`. Key evidence: existing hydration warning message (h5, h7), existing test sample html-tag-hydration-2 model to extend (h4, h17), raw-mismatch/raw-repair samples for ``/raw hydration test patterns (h13, h16, h18, h19), hydration test runner (h10), and `{@html}` documentation pages to update (h0, h6).
